definitions.explanation: The act of going back home or to one's original location.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧した。
examples.english: I did some shopping on my way home.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}くなる→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。

examples.english: Going and coming back / Round trip

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a friend on my way home from work.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The train on the way back was crowded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped by the convenience store on my way home from school.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧ですか？
examples.english: What time will you be back?
I got caught in the rain on the way home.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for them to come home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I took a taxi on the way home from the drinking party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帰|かえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ので、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：00811_shinpai⟧。
examples.english: Father's return is late, so Mother is worried.

notes:
{帰|かえ}り is a noun meaning 'return' or 'way home,' derived from the verb ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the way home
- 〜の{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the way back from ~
- {帰|かえ}り⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: the way home (route)
- ⟦{行|い}き→行き：02614_iki⟧{帰|かえ}り: round trip, there and back
- {帰|かえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: (someone's) return is late

EXAMPLES OF USAGE:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧の{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the way home from work
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧の{帰|かえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the way home from school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き→行き：02614_iki⟧: going, outward journey (antonym)
- ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return (verb form)
